explanation: 正確答案是 D「Not at all.」在回應 Would you mind...? 時表示「不介意」，也就是願意幫忙開窗。A 談的是打開書；B 沒有恰當回應請求；C 只談窗戶材質。
solutionSteps: ["Mei 因教室悶熱而委婉請求同學開窗。","此處要選擇表示不介意並願意配合的回應，而不是談窗戶材質或其他物品。","選 Not at all.；其他選項未恰當回應請求。"]
teacherTip: 回答 Would you mind ...? 時，Not at all 通常表示不介意、願意配合。

subject: 英文
question: The class is choosing one photo for a poster that will be displayed across the hallway. Yuki cannot decide between several pictures. Her classmate points to the image with a clear blue sky and says, “_____ The one with the blue sky is easier to see.” Yuki agrees.
optionB: How did you take the bus?
optionD: Why don't you choose this one?
answerText: Why don't you choose this one?
explanation: 正解是 Why don't you choose this one?，是在對方難以選擇照片時提出建議，後句也說明推薦藍天照片的理由。其他選項分別問搭車、提供食物及詢問商店時間，與照片選擇無關。
solutionSteps: ["Yuki 正在為走廊海報挑照片，同學指向藍天清楚的那一張。","後句說明推薦照片較容易看清楚，因此空格應是提出選擇建議。","選 Why don't you choose this one?，其他選項與照片話題無關。"]
teacherTip: 建議句常以 Why don't you ...? 或 You could ... 開頭。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 辨識日常對話中的道歉回應
question: During a crowded school assembly, Leo accidentally steps on another student's foot while finding his seat. He immediately apologizes. The student sees that it was unintentional and replies, “_____ It was an accident.”
explanation: 正解是 That's all right.，用來回應道歉，表示沒關係。Here you are 用於遞交物品，Good luck 用於祝福，Same to you 用於回應相同的祝福或問候，都不適合此處。
solutionSteps: ["Leo 在擁擠的集會中不小心踩到同學的腳，並立刻道歉。","對方知道這不是故意的，因此合適回應是接受道歉、表示沒關係。","選 That's all right.；其他片語各有不同語用情境。"]
teacherTip: 熟悉道歉、感謝與祝福的常見回應，注意其使用情境。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 區分公告中的活動日期、地點與登記期限
question: NOTICE: The school nurse will give free eye checks in Room 204 on Tuesday. Students who want a check should sign up with their homeroom teacher by Monday. Each check takes about five minutes.  What should an interested student do?
optionB: Go to Room 204 on Monday for the check.
optionC: Sign up with the homeroom teacher by Monday.
optionD: Bring a parent to school on Tuesday.
answerText: Sign up with the homeroom teacher by Monday.
explanation: 正解是 Sign up with the homeroom teacher by Monday.，公告要求有意願的學生最遲在星期一當天向導師登記。檢查安排在星期二，不是星期一；公告說免費，且沒有要求家長陪同。
solutionSteps: ["找出有意參加者的指示：sign up with their homeroom teacher。","確認期限是 by Monday（最遲星期一），檢查地點和日期則是星期二的 204 教室。","選 C；其他選項誤讀日期或加入未公告的要求。"]
teacherTip: 公告中的日期要分別標出活動日、報名期限與地點。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 理解公告中的交換規則與限制
question: NOTICE: The school will hold a used-book exchange in the cafeteria this Thursday. Bring books in good condition before 12:00 noon. For each qualifying book you bring, you may take one different book home. Nina plans to bring three books, but one has several torn pages. How many books can she exchange?
explanation: 交換規則以書況良好的合格書為單位：每帶一本才能換一本不同的書。Nina 帶三本但其中一本有多頁破損，不符合 good condition，因此可用兩本合格書換兩本。
solutionSteps: ["Nina 準備三本書，但公告只接受 good condition 的書。","有多頁破損的一本不合資格，所以只有兩本可參加交換。","每本合格書可換一本不同的書，因此可換兩本，選 Two。"]
teacherTip: 讀規則時注意 each、per、only 等限定詞，它們常決定答案。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 讀取公告中的條件與替代地點
question: NOTICE: The school photo will be taken on Wednesday morning. Students should wear their regular school uniform. If it rains, the photo will be taken in the gym instead of the courtyard. On Wednesday, dark clouds gather and rain begins before the photographer arrives. Where should students go for the photo?
explanation: 正解是 In the gym。公告清楚說明如果下雨，照片會改在體育館拍。庭院是晴天時原定的地點；圖書館與教室均未提及。
solutionSteps: ["找出公告中的條件句 If it rains。","閱讀條件發生時的替代地點 in the gym。","選 In the gym；其他地點不符合下雨時的安排。"]
teacherTip: 公告若同時列出原計畫與備案，注意 if、instead 等條件和轉換線索。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 擷取公告中的自備物品與主辦方提供物
question: NOTICE: The school cooking club will meet in the home economics room after school on Thursday. Members should bring an apron. The club will provide all ingredients for vegetable soup. Mei has an apron but has not bought any vegetables. Does she need to buy ingredients before the meeting?
optionA: Yes, all members must bring vegetables.
optionB: Yes, but only after the meeting.
optionC: No, because the meeting is canceled.
optionD: No, the club will provide all ingredients.
answerText: No, the club will provide all ingredients.
explanation: 社員要自備的是圍裙，食材則由社團提供。Mei 已有圍裙，不需要另外購買蔬菜或其他材料。
solutionSteps: ["公告分別列出社員自備圍裙，以及社團供應全部食材。","Mei 已有圍裙；vegetables 屬於 ingredients，包含在社團提供的材料中。","選 No, the club will provide all ingredients；她不需事先買蔬菜。"]
teacherTip: 區分 should bring 和 will provide，確認物品由誰準備。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 根據公告辨認臨時變更的活動地點
question: NOTICE: The school art room will be unavailable from March 3 to March 7 because new tables are being installed. The art club normally meets there every Thursday, but meetings during that week will take place in Room 105. The club still meets on Thursday, March 6. Where should members go that day?
explanation: 正解是 In Room 105。公告表示美術教室暫停使用期間，社團改在 105 教室開會。美術教室在該週不能使用，其他地點也未提到。
solutionSteps: ["確認美術教室在 March 3 to March 7 暫停使用。","找出這段期間社團的替代地點 Room 105。","選 In Room 105；其他選項與公告不符。"]
teacherTip: 注意 unavailable、closed、instead 等字詞，它們常標示地點或安排變更。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 根據文章內容找出能力提升的原因
question: At the start of the school year, Eli was nervous about taking the train alone. His aunt showed him how to read the station map and check the platform number. After practicing the route with her twice, he traveled to his music lesson by himself. What helped Eli travel alone?
optionA: Moving closer to the train station
optionB: Learning the map and practicing the route with his aunt
optionC: Taking a different bus every day
answerText: Learning the map and practicing the route with his aunt
explanation: 正解是 Learning the map and practicing the route with his aunt。文章指出阿姨教 Eli 看站內地圖與月台號碼，並陪他練習路線兩次；這些準備幫助他後來獨自搭車。其餘選項沒有在文章中提到。
solutionSteps: ["找出 Eli 原本的困難：不敢獨自搭火車。","確認阿姨教他的資訊及兩次路線練習。","選 Learning the map and practicing the route with his aunt，完整涵蓋地圖教學與路線練習；其他選項沒有文本根據。"]
teacherTip: 原因題要追蹤人物從困難到成功之間做了什麼。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 根據細節判斷物品的設置目的
question: Every Wednesday, Mr. Wu leaves a basket of clean towels beside the school gym. Students can use one during sports practice and put it in a separate bag afterward. The towels are washed and returned to the basket each week. Why does Mr. Wu leave towels by the gym?
optionA: So the gym can be closed on Wednesdays
optionB: So students can take the towels home permanently
optionC: So students can use a clean towel during practice
optionD: So students can avoid sports practice
answerText: So students can use a clean towel during practice
explanation: 正解是 So students can use a clean towel during practice。文章說學生運動時可使用毛巾，之後放入指定袋子清洗。毛巾會每週洗好歸還，並非讓學生永久帶回；文章也沒有說要關閉體育館或取消練習。
solutionSteps: ["閱讀學生使用毛巾的句子，確認使用情境是 sports practice。","再看毛巾之後會被清洗並放回，判斷它是供學生使用的公用物品。","選 C「So students can use a clean towel during practice」；其餘選項與毛巾的使用和回收方式不符。"]
teacherTip: 閱讀物品使用規則時，留意 afterward、returned 等字詞所描述的後續流程。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 擷取人物為達成目標所做的改變
question: Rita wanted to save money for a bicycle. She wrote down every snack she bought for a month and noticed that she spent a lot on drinks after school. She began bringing water from home and put the money she saved in a jar. What did Rita change to save money?
optionC: She bought a more expensive snack.
explanation: 正解是 She brought water from home. Rita 發現放學後買飲料花費很多，於是開始自備水並把省下的錢存起來。文章沒有說她不去上學、改買更貴的點心或賣掉腳踏車。
solutionSteps: ["找出 Rita 花費較多的項目：放學後買飲料。","確認她採取的改變是從家裡帶水。","選 She brought water from home.，其他選項沒有文章依據。"]
teacherTip: 區分人物的目標、發現和實際採取的行動。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 辨認文章中的問題與解決方案
question: A group of students noticed that the playground had very little shade at noon. They asked the principal if they could plant small trees near the benches. The school agreed, and the students now water the trees every Friday. What problem were the students trying to solve?
optionA: Students had no place to buy lunch.
optionB: The benches were too far from the school.
optionC: The trees were growing too quickly.
optionD: There was not enough shade near the playground at noon.
answerText: There was not enough shade near the playground at noon.
explanation: 正解是 There was not enough shade near the playground at noon. 短文一開始指出遊樂場中午時幾乎沒有遮蔭，學生因此提議在長椅附近種樹。其他選項並非文章提到的問題。
solutionSteps: ["讀取學生注意到的狀況：playground had very little shade at noon。","理解種樹提議是為了解決這個問題。","選 D「There was not enough shade near the playground at noon」；其他選項與提議的原因無關。"]
teacherTip: 問題解決類閱讀題可分開標記 problem、plan 和 action。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 擷取人物相遇的地點與共同活動
question: When Mei moved to a new neighborhood, she did not know anyone nearby. She began walking her dog at the same park each evening. After a few days, she met another student who also walked a dog there. They started walking together and soon became friends. How did Mei meet the other student?
optionA: Their parents introduced them at a party.
optionB: They were classmates in the same music class.
optionC: They met while buying food after school.
optionD: They often walked their dogs at the same park.
answerText: They often walked their dogs at the same park.
explanation: 正解是 They often walked their dogs at the same park. 文章說 Mei 每晚在同一個公園遛狗，遇見另一位也在那裡遛狗的學生。其他相遇方式沒有在文章中提及。
solutionSteps: ["確認 Mei 在新社區原本不認識附近的人。","找出她遇見新朋友的地點與共同活動：同一公園遛狗。","選 D；其他選項均為文本未提及的相遇情境。"]
teacherTip: 細節題可依題目中的人物或動詞回到文章定位相關句子。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 推論重複測試對實驗結果的作用
question: The science club tested three kinds of paper airplanes. They used the same paper and threw each plane from the same line. The club members measured how far each plane flew and repeated each test three times. Why did they repeat each test?
optionA: To make their results more reliable
optionB: To change the paper each time
optionC: To make the planes look different
optionD: To finish the experiment without measuring
answerText: To make their results more reliable
explanation: 正解是 To make their results more reliable. 重複測試可減少單次結果偶然造成的影響，讓比較更可靠。文章說他們使用同樣的紙並測量距離，並非每次換紙、改變外觀或不測量。
solutionSteps: ["整理實驗控制方式：同種紙、同一起點、測量飛行距離。","判斷重複測試的作用是確認結果是否穩定。","選 To make their results more reliable；其他選項與實驗流程不符。"]
teacherTip: 科學短文常考實驗步驟的目的，注意相同條件與重複測量。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 判斷短文中的正確敘述與參加規定
question: A small bookstore started a weekend reading hour for children. A volunteer reads a short story aloud, and children can draw a picture of their favorite part afterward. The event is free, but families should register online because space is limited. Which statement is true?
optionA: Only adults may join the activity.
optionB: Children must buy a book at the event.
optionC: The reading hour is held every weekday.
optionD: Families should register online before attending.
answerText: Families should register online before attending.
explanation: 正解是 Families should register online before attending. 短文說活動免費，但因名額有限，家庭應先在線上登記。文章沒有要求買書，活動在週末舉辦，也明確是為兒童設計。
solutionSteps: ["找出活動的時間、對象與參加方式。","注意 because space is limited，確認需要 online register。","選 D；其餘選項與活動資訊相反或未提及。"]
teacherTip: 免費與是否需要預約是不同資訊，閱讀時分開確認。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 現在完成式否定句與 yet
question: Lena _____ her science project yet, so she is working on it now.
explanation: 正解是 hasn't finished。yet 常與現在完成式搭配，表示到目前為止尚未完成；後句 she is working on it now 也說明工作仍在進行。doesn't finish 是現在簡單式，didn't finish 指過去，won't finish 表示未來，都不符合目前尚未完成的語意。
solutionSteps: ["注意 yet 及後句現在仍在做專題的線索。","判斷完成與否連結過去到現在，且結果是目前尚未完成。","選 hasn't finished，使用現在完成式的否定形式。"]
teacherTip: 現在完成式否定句為 have/has not + 過去分詞，常搭配 yet。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: before 表示在某事件之前
question: The bus leaves at 6:40. Please arrive fifteen minutes ___ it leaves.
explanation: 公車 6:40 發車，提早十五分鐘抵達是 6:25；空格要表達在發車這件事之前，因此用 before。until 表示持續到某時，during 表示在一段期間內，for 則引出時間長度。
solutionSteps: ["先找出基準事件：公車 6:40 發車。","題目要求在發車前十五分鐘抵達，因此時間是 6:25。","before 表示「在……之前」，符合題意；其他介系詞不表示提前十五分鐘。"]
teacherTip: before + 時間／事件表示之前；until 表示持續到某時，兩者方向不同。

subject: 英文
question: Read the notice: “Workshop begins at 1:00 p.m. Please check in at least 20 minutes before it begins.” What is the latest time to check in?
explanation: 報到必須至少比下午 1:00 開始時間早 20 分鐘；1:00 減去 20 分鐘是 12:40 p.m.，再晚便不符合公告要求。
solutionSteps: ["公告給出開始時間為下午 1:00。","報到時間至少要提早 20 分鐘，從 1:00 減去 20 分鐘。","最晚報到時間是 12:40 p.m.；1:20 是開始後，1:00 則沒有提早。"]
teacherTip: at least 20 minutes before 是最少提早 20 分鐘；latest time 指符合條件的最晚時刻。

subject: 英文
question: Evan has lived in this neighborhood ___ 2021, and he still lives here.
explanation: 現在完成式表示過去開始且延續到現在的狀態；2021 是開始的時間點，所以用 since。for 後面要接 five years 這類一段時間。
solutionSteps: ["has lived 且 still lives here 表示過去開始、延續到現在。","2021 是開始的時間點，不是一段時間長度。","since 接起始時間點；for 才接 five years 這類期間。"]
teacherTip: since + 起始點；for + 時間長度。先判斷空格後是 point 還是 period。
relatedWords: ["since 2021（自 2021 年起）","for five years（五年之久）","present perfect（現在完成式）"]

subject: 英文
question: The path was slippery after the rain, so the hikers walked ___.
explanation: 空格描述登山者如何行走，修飾動詞 walked，應使用副詞 carefully。careful 是形容詞、carefulness 是名詞，而 more careful 也不能直接修飾動詞。
solutionSteps: ["找出空格修飾的字：walked 是動詞。","修飾動作方式要用副詞，而不是形容詞或名詞。","carefully 是副詞，表示小心地行走。"]
teacherTip: 動詞通常由副詞修飾；careful 是形容詞，carefully 是副詞。
relatedWords: ["careful（小心的，形容詞）","carefully（小心地，副詞）","slippery（濕滑的）"]

subject: 英文
question: While their parents are away, Nina will ___ her younger brother after school.
explanation: 父母不在時，Nina 要負責照顧弟弟；look after 表示照料。look up 是查詢資料，look into 是調查，look over 是快速檢查。
solutionSteps: ["parents are away 說明弟弟需要有人照顧。","判斷片語動詞的語意：題目不是查資料或調查。","look after 表示照料某人，符合情境。"]
teacherTip: look after + 人／事物＝照顧；不要和 look up（查詢）混淆。
relatedWords: ["look after（照顧）","take care of（照料）","look up（查詢）"]

subject: 英文
question: If the weather stays clear tonight, the science club ___ the telescope outside.
explanation: 這是可能發生的未來條件句：if 子句用現在簡單式 stays，結果子句用 will + 原形動詞，因此答案是 will set up。
solutionSteps: ["If the weather stays clear 描述可能發生的條件。","第一類條件句的 if 子句用現在簡單式，結果子句用 will + 原形動詞。","因此選 will set up；would set up 通常用於假設性較高的第二類條件句。"]
teacherTip: 第一類條件句：If + 現在簡單式，主句常用 will + 原形動詞。
relatedWords: ["if-clause（條件子句）","will + verb（未來結果）","set up（架設）"]

subject: 英文
question: “Would you mind closing the door?” “___ The wind is blowing the papers around.”
explanation: Would you mind...? 是委婉請求；Not at all 表示「一點也不介意」，在此即表示願意關門。後句提到風把紙吹得到處都是，也說明關門的理由。
solutionSteps: ["Would you mind + V-ing 是委婉請求。","Not at all 表示「一點也不介意」，在此是答應幫忙。","其他選項談過去、材料或拒絕，無法配合紙張被風吹亂的情境。"]
teacherTip: 回應 Would you mind...? 時，Not at all 通常表示樂意；Yes, I do 表示介意。
relatedWords: ["Would you mind...?（你介意……嗎？）","Not at all.（一點也不介意）","blow around（被吹得四散）"]

subject: 英文
question: Read the notice: “The main entrance is closed while the floor is being repaired. Please use the west entrance until 5:00 p.m.” A visitor arrives at 3:30 p.m. while the repairs are still underway. Which entrance should the visitor use?
explanation: 公告說主要入口在地板施工期間關閉，並要求訪客改走西側入口至下午 5:00。訪客在 3:30 p.m. 抵達且施工仍在進行，因此應使用 west entrance。
solutionSteps: ["先找出 main entrance 關閉的原因與期間。","公告直接給出替代安排：use the west entrance。","因此目前應走 west entrance，而不是自行推測其他入口。"]
teacherTip: 功能性閱讀要區分目前規定、期限及未提及的選項。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 形容詞 + enough + to 不定詞
question: The backpack is light ___ for Jo to carry on the long walk.
explanation: 句型為形容詞 + enough + to 不定詞，因此是 light enough for Jo to carry（夠輕，Jo 可以背）。too 表示太……，so 和 such 則要搭配不同句型。
solutionSteps: ["空格前是形容詞 light，後面接 for Jo to carry。","enough 放在形容詞之後，表示「夠輕，可以……」。","所以是 light enough for Jo to carry。"]
teacherTip: enough 修飾形容詞時放在形容詞後；修飾名詞時則放在名詞前。
relatedWords: ["light enough（夠輕）","too heavy（太重）","to carry（可以搬／背）"]

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 依上下文判斷片語意思
question: The printer stopped working during the exam, so the office marked it “___” and called a technician.
explanation: 正解是 out of order（故障）：印表機停止運作，辦公室便將它如此標示。on purpose 表示故意，in a hurry 表示匆忙，by hand 表示用手，因此都不適合描述設備故障。
solutionSteps: ["停印並需要 technician，表示機器故障。","out of order 用來形容設備不能正常運作。","因此應貼上 out of order，而非描述人的行動方式的其他片語。"]
teacherTip: out of order 常用於故障設備；不要把它和 out of date（過時）混為一談。
relatedWords: ["out of order（故障）","out of date（過時）","technician（技術人員）"]

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 整合段落線索推論目的
question: Read the passage: “At first, the school recycling station accepted only plastic bottles. After students asked for a place to collect paper cups, the station added a separate bin and posted signs showing what could go in it. In the next month, fewer mixed items were found in the bins.” Why did the school add the signs?
optionA: To announce that recycling had ended
optionB: To ask students to bring more plastic bottles
optionD: To explain which items belong in each bin
answerText: To explain which items belong in each bin
explanation: 正解是 To explain which items belong in each bin. 文章明說標示會告訴學生各個回收桶可以放哪些物品，之後混放的情形也減少。因此標示的目的是協助正確分類，而不是結束回收或撤掉紙杯回收桶。
solutionSteps: ["注意 signs 後面的資訊：showing what could go in each bin。","這些標示可協助學生把物品放到正確分類區。","所以標示的目的是說明各桶可放哪些物品。"]
teacherTip: 推論目的時，先找文章明說的功能，再連結後續結果；不要只依常識猜測。
relatedWords: ["separate bin（分類桶）","sort（分類）","mixed items（混雜物品）"]

subject: 英文
question: The student ___ won the science prize will speak at the assembly.
explanation: 空格的先行詞 the student 指人，後面的關係子句缺少 won 的主詞；who 可指人並在子句中作主詞。
solutionSteps: ["先找出先行詞：the student，指人。","空格後的 won 需要子句主詞。","who 可指人並作為子句主詞；which 指物，where 指地點。"]
teacherTip: who 指人；which 指物；where 指地點。判斷關係代名詞時同時看先行詞和子句缺少的成分。

subject: 英文
question: The final list of team members ___ on the school website tomorrow.
explanation: 名單是被公布的內容，因此要用被動語態；tomorrow 表示未來，未來被動句型是 will be + 過去分詞，答案為 will be posted。
solutionSteps: ["主詞 the final list 是被公布的內容，不是執行公布的人。","tomorrow 表示未來；被動語態用 will be + 過去分詞。","post 的過去分詞是 posted，因此選 will be posted。"]
teacherTip: 未來被動：will be + p.p.；先確認主詞是執行動作還是承受動作。
relatedWords: ["post a list（公布名單）","be posted（被公布）","tomorrow（明天）"]

subject: 英文
question: We look forward to ___ from you about the exchange program.
explanation: 固定片語 look forward to 中的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或動名詞；hear 的動名詞是 hearing，因此用 look forward to hearing from you。
solutionSteps: ["辨認固定片語 look forward to，這裡的 to 是介系詞。","介系詞後接名詞或動名詞，不接原形動詞。","hear 的動名詞是 hearing，因此句子應為 look forward to hearing from you。"]
teacherTip: 常見介系詞 to 片語：look forward to, be used to；後面接名詞或 V-ing。
relatedWords: ["look forward to（期待）","hear from（收到……消息）","exchange program（交換計畫）"]

subject: 英文
unit: 功能性閱讀與時間計算
knowledgePoint: 依時間表計算活動長度
question: Read the schedule: “Robot demo: 2:15–3:00 p.m.; art show: 3:20–4:05 p.m.” How long is the robot demonstration?
explanation: 機器人示範從下午 2:15 到 3:00；先算 2:15 到 3:00 的整點，共 45 分鐘。不要把下一場藝術展前的空檔算入。
solutionSteps: ["只計算 robot demo 的開始與結束時間，勿把兩活動間的空檔算進去。","2:15 到 3:00：先到 2:15 到 3:00 的整點，共 45 分鐘。","活動長度是 45 minutes；3:20 是下一場 art show 的開始。"]
teacherTip: 跨整點計算時，可先算到整點再加總；注意不要把場次間隔當成活動時間。

subject: 英文
question: The team practiced in the rain for two hours. ___, they still felt prepared for the tournament.
explanation: 第一句描述雨中練習兩小時的困難情況，第二句卻說隊員仍覺得準備好了，兩句形成轉折，所以用 However。Therefore 表示因果結果，不符合此處邏輯。
solutionSteps: ["前句是雨中練習兩小時，帶有困難情況。","後句說仍覺得準備好了，與困難形成轉折。","用 However 表示「然而」；Therefore 表示結果，不符合此處關係。"]
teacherTip: 判斷連接副詞要看前後句邏輯：對比用 however，因果結果用 therefore。
relatedWords: ["however（然而，轉折）","therefore（因此，結果）","in addition（此外，補充）"]

subject: 英文
question: After two meetings, the committee reached a final ___ about the school garden.
explanation: 正解是 decision。冠詞 a 與形容詞 final 後面需要單數可數名詞；decision 是 decide 的名詞形式。decisive 是形容詞，decided 是動詞過去式或過去分詞。
solutionSteps: ["a final ___ 中，a 和 final 後面需要名詞。","decide 是動詞；decision 是表示決定的名詞。","所以應填 decision；decisive 為形容詞，decided 不能作此處名詞。"]
teacherTip: 注意詞性線索：冠詞 a/an 後通常要接單數可數名詞；decide → decision。
relatedWords: ["decide（決定，動詞）","decision（決定，名詞）","decisive（果斷的，形容詞）"]

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 整合公告條件判斷可行安排
question: Read the announcement: “The rooftop garden is closed during repairs this week. The seed workshop will continue in Room 204 at its usual time. Please enter through the east hall because the west stairs are being painted.” Where should workshop participants go?
explanation: 正解是 Room 204 through the east hall. 公告只說屋頂花園在維修期間關閉，種子工作坊仍照常在 204 教室舉行；西側樓梯油漆中，參加者要從東側走廊進入。因此應由 east hall 前往 Room 204。
solutionSteps: ["分辨哪項活動關閉：只有 rooftop garden during repairs。","公告明說 seed workshop 照常在 Room 204 舉行，且入口走 east hall。","把地點與路線合併，應從 east hall 前往 Room 204。"]
teacherTip: 公告可能同時交代活動地點、是否取消及替代動線；分開找出每個條件再整合。
relatedWords: ["during repairs（維修期間）","continue as usual（照常進行）","enter through（由……進入）"]

subject: 英文
question: During the storm, the power went out. Dad lit a candle so we could see the room. What does “went out” mean here?
explanation: 語境依據：The storm left the room dark, so Dad needed a candle. 判斷：In this context, “the power went out” means the electricity stopped working. 正確答案為 A「stopped working」。易錯提示：“Moved outside” describes a person or object changing location; the sentence is about the electricity supply.
solutionSteps: ["暴風雨後停電，爸爸點蠟燭讓房間看得見；這兩個線索都指向電力中斷。","片語 go out 用在 power 時表示「停止供電」，不是人或物走到外面。","所以選 A stopped working。易錯點：同一片語會依主詞改變意思；燈或電力 go out 是熄滅／中斷。"]
teacherTip: 用停電後點蠟燭的因果線索判斷片語；go out 用於人時才可能表示外出。

subject: 英文
question: Lena ___ in Taichung since she started college five years ago.
explanation: 語境依據：“Since she started college five years ago” gives a starting point that continues to now. 判斷：Use the present perfect, “has lived,” for a situation that began in the past and continues in the present. 正確答案為 C「has lived」。易錯提示：“Lived” suggests the situation ended; “lives” and “is living” do not match the since-clause as naturally here.
solutionSteps: ["since 子句給出五年前開始的時間點；題目沒有說 Lena 已離開台中。","這段居住狀態從過去延續到現在，主句應用現在完成式；主詞 Lena 是第三人稱單數，因此用 has。","選 C has lived。易錯點：since 接起點，for 接期間；若只說 lived，通常表示這段居住已結束。"]
teacherTip: since + 起始點常搭現在完成式；還要檢查主詞決定 have 或 has。

subject: 英文
question: The school library ___ every evening, so it is clean for students the next morning.
explanation: 語境依據：The library receives the action, and “every evening” describes a regular routine. 判斷：Use the present simple passive, “is cleaned”: be + past participle. 正確答案為 B「is cleaned」。易錯提示：“Cleans” makes the library do the cleaning; “cleaned” lacks the needed passive auxiliary.
solutionSteps: ["主詞 the school library 是被清掃的地方，不會自己清掃；every evening 表示固定例行工作。","固定工作用現在簡單式，被動語態結構是 be + 過去分詞；單數 library 要配 is。","選 B is cleaned。易錯點：cleans 變成圖書館主動清掃；cleaned 少了被動助動詞。"]
teacherTip: 先辨認主詞是動作執行者或承受者，再看 every evening 決定時態。
relatedWords: ["passive voice（被動語態）","past participle（過去分詞）"]

subject: 英文
question: The woman ___ lives next door is a nurse who helped my grandmother.
explanation: 語境依據：The blank refers to “the woman,” a person, and it is the subject of “lives.” 判斷：“Who” is the subject relative pronoun for a person. 正確答案為 C「who」。易錯提示：“Which” usually refers to things; “whose” shows possession; “where” refers to a place.
solutionSteps: ["空格後的 lives 缺主詞，先行詞 the woman 指人，因此需要能代替人的關係代名詞。","who 在關係子句中作 lives 的主詞；which 指物、whose 表所有關係、where 表地點。","選 C who。易錯點：不能只看先行詞是人；還要確認子句缺主詞，而不是地點或所有格。"]
teacherTip: 關係代名詞題先找先行詞，再檢查後方子句缺主詞、受詞、所有格還是地點。

subject: 英文
question: Could you tell me ___? I need to know the time of the last bus.
optionA: when does the last bus leave
optionC: when did the last bus leave
explanation: 語境依據：The sentence is an indirect question after “Could you tell me.” 判斷：An indirect question uses statement word order: subject before verb, so “when the last bus leaves.” 正確答案為 B「when the last bus leaves」。易錯提示：“When does...” and “when did...” use direct-question inversion; the last choice puts the verb before its subject.
solutionSteps: ["Could you tell me 引出間接問句；後句補充要查的是末班車時間。","間接問句的疑問詞子句採直述語序，主詞 the last bus 放在動詞 leaves 前，不倒裝也不加 does。","選 B when the last bus leaves。易錯點：不要把直接問句 When does the bus leave? 的倒裝搬進間接問句。"]
teacherTip: Could you tell me / Do you know 後的疑問詞子句用「主詞＋動詞」直述語序。

subject: 英文
question: ___ it was raining heavily, the soccer game continued because both teams had already arrived.
explanation: 語境依據：The rain would normally stop a game, but the game continued. 判斷：“Although” introduces a contrast between the heavy rain and the game continuing. 正確答案為 B「Although」。易錯提示：“Because” gives a cause, “unless” gives a condition, and “so” introduces a result.
solutionSteps: ["兩個事實是雨下得很大，以及球賽仍繼續；前後形成預期與實際結果的反差。","空格位於子句前，要接「雖然」的讓步連接詞；because 說原因，unless 表條件，so 引結果。","選 B Although。易錯點：句中雖另有 because，但它說明球賽繼續的原因，不會改變前半句與主句的轉折關係。"]
teacherTip: 先用兩子句的邏輯關係分類：原因、結果、條件或讓步，再挑連接詞。

subject: 英文
question: After dinner, Kevin offered ___ the dishes while his sister dried them.
explanation: 語境依據：“Offered” is followed by the action Kevin agreed to do. 判斷：The verb “offer” is followed by a to-infinitive: “offered to wash.” 正確答案為 C「to wash」。易錯提示：“To washing” mixes two forms; “wash” and “washing” do not fit this verb pattern.
solutionSteps: ["Kevin 主動提出洗碗，while 子句補充妹妹負責擦乾，說明空格要接他提出的動作。","offer 後接 to + 原形動詞；因此 wash 前需要 to，不能直接接 V-ing。","選 C to wash。易錯點：to washing 把不定詞和動名詞混在一起；offer to do 表「提出做某事」。"]
teacherTip: 記住 offer to do；不要和 enjoy doing、avoid doing 等接動名詞的動詞混淆。
relatedWords: ["offer to do（主動提出做某事）","to-infinitive（不定詞）"]

subject: 英文
question: You will miss the school bus ___ you leave home in the next five minutes.
explanation: 語境依據：Leaving within five minutes is the necessary exception that prevents missing the bus. 判斷：“Unless” means “if not,” so the sentence means you will miss the bus if you do not leave soon. 正確答案為 B「unless」。易錯提示：“If” reverses the intended condition; “although” shows contrast and “because” gives a reason.
solutionSteps: ["句意是「若不在五分鐘內出門，就會錯過校車」；準時出門是避免錯過的必要條件。","unless 可替換成 if ... not，代回後語意吻合；if 直接放入則會變成「若出門就會錯過」，意思相反。","選 B unless。易錯點：讀條件句時要檢查肯定／否定方向，不可只看到 will 就選 if。"]
teacherTip: 把 unless 換成 if ... not 重讀一次，確認條件的否定範圍與句意一致。

subject: 英文
question: The documentary about ocean life was so ___ that our class watched it twice.
explanation: 語境依據：The documentary causes the class to feel interested. 判斷：Use “interesting” to describe something that creates interest. 正確答案為 B「interesting」。易錯提示：“Interested” describes how a person feels; “interest” is a noun or verb, and “interestingly” is an adverb.
solutionSteps: ["主詞 documentary 是引發感受的事物；that 子句指出全班看了兩次，呈現它帶來的效果。","描述事物令人產生某感受用 -ing 形容詞；描述人的感受才用 -ed。","選 B interesting。易錯點：interested 修飾感到興趣的人；interest 是名詞／動詞，interestingly 是副詞。"]
teacherTip: -ing 表「令人……」，-ed 表「感到……」；先判斷被修飾者是事物還是人。

subject: 英文
question: Mia set an alarm ___ she would not forget to submit her science project before midnight.
explanation: 語境依據：The alarm was set to help Mia remember to submit the project. 判斷：“So that” introduces the purpose and is followed by a subject and verb. 正確答案為 A「so that」。易錯提示：“Even though” shows contrast, “as soon as” gives timing, and “instead of” means in place of.
solutionSteps: ["Mia 設鬧鐘，目標是不要忘記午夜前交科展；後半句說明設鬧鐘的目的。","空格後是完整子句 she would not forget，表示目的可用 so that + 主詞 + 動詞。","選 A so that。易錯點：even though 表轉折、as soon as 表時間、instead of 後接名詞或 V-ing，都不符合目的關係。"]
teacherTip: 辨別 so that + 子句（目的）與 so + 形容詞／副詞 + that + 子句（程度結果）。

subject: 英文
question: The notice says the museum is “accessible” by bus and train, and the entrance has a ramp for wheelchair users. What does “accessible” most nearly mean?
explanation: 大眾運輸與輪椅坡道分別提供交通和進入設施的便利，因此 accessible 在此是「容易到達或使用」。A 正確；題目沒有提到會員、票價或離市區遠近。近義詞：reachable、available。
solutionSteps: ["題幹同時提到大眾運輸可到達博物館，入口也有輪椅坡道，兩者都在說明參觀的便利性。","因此 accessible 在此指「容易到達或使用」；不是會員資格、票價或距離的資訊。","選 A easy to reach or use。近義詞有 reachable、available；易錯點是把 accessible 只理解成地理位置，而忽略設施也能讓場所更易使用。"]
teacherTip: accessible 可形容地點容易到達，也可形容服務或設施方便使用；依例子判斷語境。

subject: 英文
question: I ___ my bike home when I saw a wallet lying beside the road.
explanation: saw 是過去發生的短事件；騎車在那一刻仍持續進行，故用過去進行式 was riding。I 配 was，ride 加 -ing。rode 只陳述過去事實，沒有呈現當時正在進行。
solutionSteps: ["兩個動作都發生在過去；see a wallet 是突然發生的短動作，騎車則是當時持續中的背景動作。","持續背景用過去進行式，主詞 I 配 was，ride 要改成現在分詞 riding。","選 B was riding。易錯點：rode 雖是過去式，卻沒有凸顯「正在騎」；have ridden 與 am riding 也不符合 saw 的過去時間。"]
teacherTip: when 後的短事件常用過去簡單式；被打斷、當時正在進行的背景動作可用 was/were + V-ing。

subject: 英文
question: Ella and I brought our own lunches, but Mark forgot ___.
explanation: 空格代替名詞片語 his lunch，名詞 lunch 已省略，所以要用可獨立使用的所有格代名詞 his。D 正確；he 是主格、him 是受格、himself 是反身代名詞。
solutionSteps: ["前半句說 Ella 和 I 各自帶了午餐；but 表示 Mark 的情況不同，空格省略的是「他的午餐」。","名詞 lunch 不重複時，要用可獨立代替名詞片語的所有格代名詞 his；不能用限定詞 his lunch 的形式重複填入。","選 D his。易錯點：he 是主格、him 是受格、himself 是反身代名詞；此處需要表示「他的那份」的所有格。"]
teacherTip: his 可作所有格限定詞（his lunch），也可單獨作所有格代名詞（Mark forgot his）。

subject: 英文
question: The students listened ___ while the guide explained how the ancient bridge was built.
explanation: 空格說明 listened 的方式，修飾動詞要用副詞 carefully。B 正確；careful／more careful 是形容詞，carefulness 是名詞，不能在此修飾 listened。
solutionSteps: ["空格緊接動詞 listened，描述學生「如何聆聽」；while 子句補充導覽員正在解說古橋建造方式。","修飾動作方式要用副詞；careful 的副詞形式是 carefully。","選 B carefully。易錯點：careful／more careful 是形容詞，carefulness 是名詞，都不能直接修飾 listened。"]
teacherTip: 判斷詞性時先找空格修飾誰：修飾 listened 這類動詞通常要用副詞。

subject: 英文
question: “I left my umbrella on the bus, and it is raining hard.” “___”
optionA: You should call the bus company and ask about lost property.
optionB: You should to call the bus company and ask about lost property.
optionC: You should calling the bus company and ask about lost property.
optionD: You should called the bus company and ask about lost property.
answerText: You should call the bus company and ask about lost property.
explanation: 說話者把傘遺留在公車上，聯絡公車公司詢問失物招領是直接可行的建議，故選 A。should 後接原形動詞 call；不可接 to call、calling 或 called。
solutionSteps: ["說話者把傘留在公車上，而且正在下雨；回應應提供找回傘或眼前避雨的可行做法。","A 建議聯絡公車公司詢問失物招領，直接處理傘遺失；should 後接原形動詞 call。","選 A。易錯點：should 後不可接 to call、calling 或 called；其他回應即使句型通順，也須同時符合失物情境。"]
teacherTip: 對話題先判斷對方需要的功能（建議、請求或回應），再核對情境與助動詞後的動詞形式。
relatedWords: ["lost property（失物招領）","should + base verb（should 後接動詞原形）"]

subject: 英文
question: Read the notice: “School Garden Day: Saturday, May 18. Meet at the east gate at 8:30 a.m. Bring a hat and a reusable water bottle. The activity ends at noon.” What should participants bring?
optionA: A hat and a reusable water bottle
optionB: A lunch and a pair of gloves
answerText: A hat and a reusable water bottle
explanation: 公告以 Bring 明確列出 hat 和 reusable water bottle，故選 A。集合時間與活動結束時間不會額外推導出午餐、手套或其他未列物品。
solutionSteps: ["公告先列日期、集合時間與地點，接著用祈使句 Bring 指定參加者要自備物品。","只擷取 Bring 後列出的兩項；活動到中午結束並不代表公告要求帶午餐。","選 A：帽子與可重複使用水瓶。易錯點：不要把合理但未列出的手套、雨衣或相機自行補成規定。"]
teacherTip: 公告細節題要分清明示規定與個人推測；定位祈使句或 must／need to 等義務詞。

subject: 英文
question: Of all the science projects in the exhibition, Nora’s model of the solar system is ___.
explanation: Of all the science projects 表示在整組作品中比較最高程度；creative 用 the most creative 作最高級，選 C。more creative 用於兩者比較，creatively 則是副詞。
solutionSteps: ["Of all the science projects 把 Nora 的模型放在整個展覽作品群中比較，不是只和另一件作品相比。","creative 是多音節形容詞，表示群體中程度最高要用 the most + 形容詞。","選 C the most creative。易錯點：more creative 用於兩者比較；creatively 是副詞，不能接在 is 後作主詞補語。"]
teacherTip: 看到 of all / in the class 先辨認比較範圍；群體最高程度通常用 the + 最高級。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 不定代詞與主動詞一致
question: Each of the players ___ a team shirt before the opening ceremony.
explanation: 主詞核心是 each，players 位於 of 後，不控制主動詞。each 作單數主詞，現在簡單式用 receives，故選 B；不可被鄰近複數名詞誤導成 receive。
solutionSteps: ["主詞片語是 Each of the players；開幕典禮前每位選手各領一件隊服，動作是一般安排。","主詞核心是 each，不是介系詞 of 後面的複數 players，因此動詞用第三人稱單數現在式。","選 B receives。易錯點：不要讓最近的複數名詞 players 誘使你用 receive；each 作主詞要用單數動詞。"]
teacherTip: 主詞與動詞一致看主詞核心；each of + 複數名詞仍以 each 作單數主詞。

subject: 英文
question: Read the message: “Hi Sam, I put the soup in the refrigerator before leaving. Please heat it for three minutes when you get home. The bread is on the counter. —Mom” What should Sam do first after getting home?
optionC: Put the bread in the refrigerator
explanation: 媽媽明確交代 Sam 回家後加熱冰箱裡的湯三分鐘，所以第一件事是 heat the soup，選 A。麵包已在檯面只是位置資訊，不是要買麵包或冰麵包的指令。
solutionSteps: ["訊息把湯已放冰箱、麵包在檯面當作現況，唯一直接指示是 Sam 回家後加熱湯三分鐘。","題目問 first after getting home，依時間指示先做 heat the soup；麵包的位置只是資訊，不是動作要求。","選 A Heat the soup。易錯點：先分辨描述現況的句子與祈使指令 Please heat it，不要因出現 bread 就自行增加工作。"]
teacherTip: 讀訊息時標出時間詞和祈使句；描述物品位置不等同於要求採取行動。

subject: 英文
question: Please wait here ___ the nurse calls your name.
explanation: wait here 是持續動作，直到護理師叫名字才結束，因此用 until + 子句，選 A。while 表同時發生；after 和 before 雖可接子句，但會改變等待與叫號的先後關係。
solutionSteps: ["wait 是要持續一段時間的動作，nurse calls your name 是等待結束的界線事件。","until + 子句表示動作持續到某事件發生；while 表兩事同時進行，after／before 則改變等待與叫號的先後關係。","選 A until。易錯點：while 表同時發生，after／before 會改變等待與叫號的先後，不符合原意。"]
teacherTip: until 強調動作延續至終點；while 強調兩件事同時發生。

subject: 英文
question: There are only ___ seats left on the bus, so we can all sit together.
explanation: 語境依據：“Seats” is a plural countable noun, and the sentence says some seats remain. 判斷：Use “a few” with plural countable nouns to mean a small number. 正確答案為 B「a few」。易錯提示：“A little” and “little” go with uncountable nouns; “much” also describes an uncountable amount.
solutionSteps: ["空格後是複數名詞 seats；後句說大家還能坐在一起，表示仍剩下一些座位。","a few 修飾可數複數，表示「有幾個」；a little／little 和 much 用於不可數名詞。","選 B a few。易錯點：only 強調數量不多，不會把可數的 seats 變成不可數名詞。"]
teacherTip: 先辨認名詞可數性：a few + 可數複數；a little + 不可數名詞。
relatedWords: ["a few（少數幾個）","countable noun（可數名詞）"]

subject: 英文
question: A train leaves Hsinchu at 10:20 a.m. and arrives in Taipei 45 minutes later. At what time does it arrive?
explanation: 語境依據：The train leaves at 10:20 and the trip takes 45 minutes. 判斷：Adding 40 minutes gives 11:00; adding 5 more minutes gives 11:05. 正確答案為 D「11:05 a.m.」。易錯提示：10:55 adds only 35 minutes; 11:15 and 11:25 add 55 and 65 minutes.
solutionSteps: ["列出出發時刻 10:20 和行車時間 45 分鐘；先加 40 分鐘到 11:00。","剩下 5 分鐘，再由 11:00 往後加到 11:05；時刻跨過整點時要把分鐘重新起算。","選 D 11:05 a.m. 易錯點：10:55 只比出發晚 35 分鐘；11:15 則晚了 55 分鐘。"]
teacherTip: 時間加法可先補到整點再加餘數，最後用到達時間減出發時間驗算。

subject: 英文
question: Our class is looking forward to ___ the new sports center next month.
explanation: 語境依據：The phrase is “look forward to,” where “to” is a preposition. 判斷：A preposition is followed by a noun or gerund, so use “visiting.” 正確答案為 B「visiting」。易錯提示：The “to” here is not part of an infinitive; “visit,” “visited,” and “be visit” do not fit the phrase.
solutionSteps: ["句型 look forward to 後面接預期的活動；空格後 next month 說明參觀尚未發生。","此片語中的 to 是介系詞，不是不定詞標記，所以後面接名詞或動名詞 V-ing。","選 B visiting。易錯點：雖然多數 to V 是不定詞，但 look forward to、be used to 的 to 後接名詞／V-ing。"]
teacherTip: 比較 look forward to doing（期待做）與 want to do（想要做）；to 的詞性決定後接形式。

subject: 英文
question: At the information desk, a visitor says, “Excuse me, ___?”
optionA: could you tell me where the nearest restroom is
optionB: could you tell me where the nearest restroom
optionC: could you tell me where is the nearest restroom
optionD: could you tell me where the nearest restroom are
answerText: could you tell me where the nearest restroom is
explanation: 語境依據：The visitor is making a polite request for directions at an information desk. 判斷：“Could you tell me...” is polite, and the embedded question uses statement word order: “where the nearest restroom is.” 正確答案為 A「could you tell me where the nearest restroom is」。易錯提示：The third choice incorrectly uses direct-question order inside an indirect question; the other choices are not grammatical polite requests.
solutionSteps: ["Excuse me 和服務台情境顯示旅客要有禮貌地詢問洗手間位置。","Could you tell me 後接間接問句，疑問詞子句要用直述語序：主詞 the nearest restroom 在動詞 is 前，並須保留完整子句。","選 A。易錯點：C 把 is 倒裝到主詞前；B 缺少子句動詞，D 則把單數 restroom 誤配成 are。"]
teacherTip: 間接問句檢查兩件事：使用直述語序，且疑問詞子句要有完整主詞與動詞。

subject: 英文
question: The ground is wet and dark clouds are moving in. It ___ soon, so take an umbrella.
explanation: 語境依據：Wet ground and dark clouds suggest rain is possible, and the advice is to prepare. 判斷：“May” expresses possibility and is followed by the base verb “rain.” 正確答案為 A「may rain」。易錯提示：A modal is not followed by an -s form, an -ing form, or a past-tense form.
solutionSteps: ["地面潮濕且烏雲正在靠近，提供降雨可能性的線索；so take an umbrella 是預防建議，不代表必定會下雨。","may 表不確定的可能性，情態助動詞後接原形動詞 rain。","選 A may rain。易錯點：may rains、may raining、may rained 都違反情態助動詞 + 原形動詞的結構。"]
teacherTip: 情態助動詞後接原形；再依證據強弱判斷 may（可能）與 must（必定）的語氣差異。

subject: 英文
question: A map lists the new bridge as 120 meters long and the wooden bridge as 80 meters long. How much longer is the new bridge?
explanation: 新橋長 120 公尺、木橋長 80 公尺；題目問相差多少，計算 120 − 80 = 40 公尺，選 B。不要把新橋的總長 120 公尺誤當成「多出」的長度。
solutionSteps: ["地圖提供新橋 120 公尺、木橋 80 公尺兩個總長；所求是兩橋長度差，不是新橋本身長度。","用較長的橋減較短的橋：120 − 80 = 40。","答案為 B 40 meters。易錯點：120 是新橋總長，200 是兩橋長度相加，都不是差值。"]
teacherTip: 數據題先辨認問題問總量、差值或倍數；標示數字不一定就是答案。
relatedWords: ["long（長，原級）","longer（較長，比較級）","longest（最長，最高級）"]

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 閱讀公告與擷取重要資訊
question: Read the notice: “During exam week, the library will stay open until 7 p.m. on Thursday. Students may borrow two extra books that day. All books must be returned by June 14. The library is closed on Friday for cleaning.” Which statement is true?
optionA: Students may borrow two extra books on Thursday.
optionB: The library is open until 7 p.m. every Friday.
optionC: Books borrowed on Thursday may be returned after June 14.
optionD: Students can use the library while it is closed on Friday.
answerText: Students may borrow two extra books on Thursday.
explanation: 公告明確指出考試週星期四圖書館延長開放，且學生當天可多借兩本書，因此 A 正確。星期五是閉館清潔；六月十四日是歸還期限，不可推論能逾期歸還。
solutionSteps: ["定位公告中的時間與規定：星期四延長開放，並可多借兩本書。","逐一比對選項；星期五閉館，且所有書都須在六月十四日前歸還。","答案為 A Students may borrow two extra books on Thursday. 易錯點：不要把星期四的延長開放誤套到星期五。"]
teacherTip: 公告題要分辨開放時間、日期、額外權益與期限；某項規定通常只適用於文中指明的日期。
relatedWords: ["borrow（借用）","return（歸還）","closed for cleaning（因清潔而閉館）"]

subject: 英文
question: At dawn, the valley thermometer reads 14°C. The mountain station is 4°C colder. What temperature does the mountain thermometer read?
explanation: 山區比谷地低 4°C，谷地是 14°C，因此山區為 14 − 4 = 10°C，選 D。較冷代表溫度數值較小，不能把 4°C 當成山區的實際溫度。
solutionSteps: ["谷地溫度是 14°C；mountain station 低 4°C，表示要從谷地數值扣除 4。","14 − 4 = 10；低溫代表較小的攝氏數值，不是把 4 加上去。","答案為 D 10°C。易錯點：4°C 是兩地溫差，14°C 才是谷地溫度。"]
teacherTip: 溫差題先確認方向：較冷／低幾度通常用基準溫度減去溫差。
relatedWords: ["cold（冷，原級）","colder（較冷，比較級）","coldest（最冷，最高級）"]

subject: 英文
question: A reading lamp is labeled “900 lumens,” while an older lamp is labeled “600 lumens.” What does this tell us about the reading lamp?
explanation: Lumens measure the amount of visible light a lamp gives out. Since 900 lumens is greater than 600 lumens, the reading lamp gives more light. The correct answer is A, “It gives more light.” The label does not provide information about weight, price, or temperature.
solutionSteps: ["先判斷單位 lumens 測量燈具發出的可見光量，不是重量、價格或溫度。","比較標示數字：900 流明大於 600 流明，表示新閱讀燈的光輸出較大。","答案為 A It gives more light。易錯點：標籤只提供流明數，不能據此推論其他產品特性。"]
teacherTip: 讀產品數據前先確認單位代表的物理量；流明描述光通量／光輸出。

subject: 英文
unit: 功能性閱讀與時間計算
knowledgePoint: 閱讀訊息並推論適當行動
question: Read the message: “Maya, the school bus will not run after the concert on Friday. I can drive you home, but I have to leave before the concert ends. Please text me before it starts so I can help arrange another ride. —Dad” What should Maya do?
optionA: Wait until the concert ends, then ask the driver to bring her home.
optionB: Leave the concert early without telling anyone.
optionC: Text her dad before the concert starts to arrange a ride.
optionD: Take the school bus after the concert as usual.
answerText: Text her dad before the concert starts to arrange a ride.
explanation: 父親表示演唱會結束後沒有校車，而且自己必須先離開，並請 Maya 在活動開始前傳訊息安排其他接送方式，因此 C 正確。
solutionSteps: ["找出交通問題：演唱會結束後校車不行駛，父親也無法等到活動結束。","父親明確要求 Maya 在演唱會開始前傳訊息，才能協助安排其他接送方式。","答案為 C Text her dad before the concert starts to arrange a ride. 易錯點：不能把「父親願意開車」誤讀成他可以在活動結束後接她。"]
teacherTip: 訊息推論要整合轉折與時間限制；Dad 願意幫忙，但他必須在活動結束前離開。
relatedWords: ["arrange a ride（安排接送）","run（此處指交通工具營運）","before it starts（在活動開始前）"]

subject: 英文
unit: 功能性閱讀與金錢計算
knowledgePoint: 依單位費用計算節省金額
question: Buying a new bottle costs $8 each week. Using a refill bottle costs $4 each week. How much can a student save in four weeks by using the refill bottle?
explanation: The weekly saving is $8 − $4 = $4. Over four weeks, the student saves 4 × $4 = $16.
solutionSteps: ["Find the weekly difference: $8 − $4 = $4 saved each week.","Multiply the weekly saving by four weeks.","$4 × 4 = $16; choose C."]
teacherTip: Find the per-week saving first, then multiply by the number of weeks.

subject: 英文
question: The observation tower is ___ than the gym; its roof is 48 meters high, while the gym roof is 12 meters high.
explanation: The roof heights directly show that the tower is higher than the gym. The sentence compares two things with “than,” so it needs the comparative form. “Tall” becomes “taller” by adding -er. The correct answer is taller.
solutionSteps: ["Compare the explicit roof heights: 48 meters for the tower and 12 meters for the gym.","“Than” compares two people or things, so use a comparative adjective rather than the base form or a superlative.","The comparative of “tall” is “taller” (it is a one-syllable adjective, so add -er); choose D, “taller.”"]
teacherTip: Use measured height, not floor count, as evidence that one building is taller.
relatedWords: ["tall（高，原級）","taller（較高，比較級）","tallest（最高，最高級）"]

subject: 英文
question: Three local structures were built in different years: the stone wall in 1890, the clock tower in 1970, and the railway station in 2005. Which structure is the oldest?
optionD: They opened in the same year.
explanation: The question compares three structures, so it asks for the superlative “oldest,” not a comparative between two items. The stone wall was built in 1890, earlier than the clock tower in 1970 and the station in 2005; therefore the wall is the oldest. Correct answer: A.
solutionSteps: ["Identify that three structures are being compared, which calls for a superlative.","Order the dates: 1890 is earlier than 1970 and 2005.","The stone wall is the oldest, so choose A."]
teacherTip: Use a comparative for two items and a superlative for a group of three or more; check the reference set before choosing.

subject: 英文
question: A sound meter reads 95 dB for the fire alarm and 75 dB for the classroom bell. How many decibels higher is the alarm reading?
explanation: Subtract the bell reading from the alarm reading: 95 − 75 = 20 dB. Therefore the alarm reading is 20 dB higher; 170 dB is the sum, and 75 dB is only the bell's reading.
solutionSteps: ["Locate the two measurements: 95 dB for the alarm and 75 dB for the bell.","The question asks for the difference, so subtract the smaller reading from the larger one.","95 − 75 = 20 dB; choose B."]
teacherTip: For “how many higher,” subtract the smaller measurement from the larger; do not add the readings.

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 比較級句型與形容詞變化
question: A draft report says, “The beach looked more clean after the cleanup than it did on Monday.” Which correction should the writer make?
explanation: The sentence compares the beach after cleanup with how it looked on Monday, so it needs a comparative adjective before “than.” For a one-syllable adjective like “clean,” add -er: “cleaner.” The correct answer is A.
solutionSteps: ["Identify the two conditions being compared: after the cleanup and Monday.","The word “than” calls for a comparative form, not a superlative or the base form.","“Clean” is one syllable, so its comparative is “cleaner.” Choose A."]
teacherTip: When revising a comparison with “than,” use the comparative form; for one-syllable “clean,” add -er.
relatedWords: ["clean（乾淨，原級）","cleaner（較乾淨，比較級）","cleanest（最乾淨，最高級）"]

teacherTip: Comparison clue: The new rope can hold a heavier load. It is a one-syllable adjective, so add -er.

solutionSteps: ["Find the comparison: The trail reaches the greater elevation.","“Than” compares two people or things, so use a comparative adjective rather than the base form or a superlative.","The comparative of “high” is “higher” (it is a one-syllable adjective, so add -er); choose C, “higher.”"]
teacherTip: Comparison clue: The trail reaches the greater elevation. It is a one-syllable adjective, so add -er.

subject: 英文
question: The harbor is 20 m deep, the lake is 8 m deep, and the pond is 2 m deep. Which place is the shallowest?
explanation: Compare the three depths: 20 m, 8 m, and 2 m. The pond is the least deep, so it is the shallowest.
solutionSteps: ["List the depths for all three places: harbor 20 m, lake 8 m, and pond 2 m.","The shallowest place has the smallest depth measurement.","2 m is the smallest value, so the pond is the shallowest; choose C."]
teacherTip: For shallowest, compare the measurements and select the smallest depth.

subject: 英文
question: The north road is 4 km long and the south road is 9 km long. How much farther is the south road?
explanation: Subtract the north road's 4 km from the south road's 9 km: 9 − 4 = 5 km. The south road is 5 km farther.
solutionSteps: ["Identify the two distances: north road 4 km and south road 9 km.","To find how much farther one route is, subtract the shorter distance from the longer distance.","9 − 4 = 5 km; choose B."]
teacherTip: Check the subtraction order: longer distance minus shorter distance gives the difference.

subject: 英文
question: A sound meter reads 35 dB before the classroom windows are closed and 48 dB afterward. Which sentence compares the readings correctly?
optionA: The room is louder after the windows are closed.
optionB: The room is loudest after the windows are closed.
optionC: The room is more loud after the windows are closed.
optionD: The room is as louder after the windows are closed.
answerText: The room is louder after the windows are closed.
explanation: The reading increases from 35 dB to 48 dB, so the classroom is louder after the windows are closed. A comparative is used to compare the two conditions; “loud” takes -er. “Loudest” needs a group of three or more, “more loud” is not the standard form here, and “as louder” is ungrammatical. The correct answer is A.
solutionSteps: ["Compare the two measurements: 48 dB is greater than 35 dB.","The sentence compares two conditions, so use the comparative form rather than the superlative.","“Loud” becomes “louder”; choose A."]
teacherTip: Choose a comparative when two conditions are compared; use a superlative only when selecting from a larger group.
relatedWords: ["loud（大聲，原級）","louder（較大聲，比較級）","loudest（最大聲，最高級）"]

question: The outdoor concert will move to the gym if it rains. The forecast predicts rain during the concert. Where should ticket holders go if it rains?

solutionSteps: ["Find the condition in the notice: if it rains, the concert moves indoors.","Match the forecast to that condition: rain is predicted during the concert.","Ticket holders should go to the gym; choose A."]
teacherTip: For an if-clause in a notice, match the stated condition to its stated action; do not assume cancellation.

subject: 英文
question: A parcel measures 40 × 30 × 20 cm. Its volume is how many times that of a 30 × 20 × 10 cm parcel?
explanation: The first parcel's volume is 40 × 30 × 20 = 24,000 cm³. The second is 30 × 20 × 10 = 6,000 cm³. Since 24,000 ÷ 6,000 = 4, the correct answer is 4 times (option B). The answer is not 3 times.
solutionSteps: ["Calculate the first volume: 40 × 30 × 20 = 24,000 cm³.","Calculate the second volume: 30 × 20 × 10 = 6,000 cm³.","Divide 24,000 by 6,000. The answer is B, 4 times."]
teacherTip: For rectangular prisms, multiply length × width × height before comparing volumes.
relatedWords: ["volume（體積）","rectangular prism（長方體）","cubic centimeter（立方公分）"]

subject: 英文
question: Could you tell me when the art room ___? I need to return the brushes before then.

subject: 英文
question: A jacket's waist measures 70 cm, while the sample measures 76 cm. How much smaller is the jacket's waist?
explanation: Subtract 70 cm from 76 cm: 76 − 70 = 6 cm. The jacket's waist is 6 cm smaller. The correct answer is B, “6 cm.” The answer is not 4 cm.
solutionSteps: ["Compare the two measurements: 76 cm and 70 cm.","Find the difference: 76 − 70 = 6 cm.","The correct answer is B, 6 cm."]
teacherTip: A smaller waist measurement does not by itself describe the whole jacket or person; answer only the measured difference.

subject: 英文
question: Last month, the team could run 2 km before stopping. After following a training plan, it can run 5 km. Which statement is supported by the information?
optionA: The team can run farther without stopping now.
optionB: The team has less running endurance now.
optionC: The team runs exactly five days each week.
optionD: Every player is faster than every other team.
answerText: The team can run farther without stopping now.
explanation: The stated distance increased from 2 km to 5 km before stopping. This supports A, “The team can run farther without stopping now.” The passage does not say how many days they train or compare them with another team.
solutionSteps: ["Find the two measured distances: 2 km before and 5 km after training.","Compare the result: 5 km is farther than 2 km before stopping.","The correct answer is A. Do not infer training frequency or race results that are not stated."]
teacherTip: A supported inference must match the measured evidence; do not add unstated details.

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 閱讀公告並判斷替代路線
question: A red warning light measures 20 cd/m² and a green indicator measures 10 cd/m². Which sentence expresses their brightness ratio correctly?
optionA: The red light is twice as bright as the green one.
optionB: The red light is twice brighter than the green one.
optionC: The red light is the brightest than the green one.
optionD: The red light is as bright twice as the green one.
answerText: The red light is twice as bright as the green one.
explanation: The red light’s measured brightness is 20÷10＝2 times the green light’s. The correct multiplier pattern is “twice as + adjective + as,” so the answer is A. “Twice brighter” is not the standard form for expressing this ratio, while C and D put the comparison words in the wrong pattern.
solutionSteps: ["Divide the readings: 20÷10＝2, so the red light is two times as bright.","For a multiplier comparison, use “twice as + adjective + as.”","The complete sentence is “twice as bright as,” so choose A."]
teacherTip: Use “twice as ... as” for a ratio; reserve “-er than” for an ordinary comparative statement.
relatedWords: ["bright（明亮，原級）","brighter（較明亮，比較級）","brightest（最明亮，最高級）"]

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 依情境目標與限制選擇可行行動
question: Mia's phone has 2% battery left, and she must scan her ticket at the station gate. She has ten minutes before boarding. What should she do first?
optionA: Turn on a video and wait for the gate.
optionB: Turn the screen brightness all the way up.
optionC: Delete the ticket and buy another one immediately.
optionD: Find a charger or ask staff where she can charge the phone.
answerText: Find a charger or ask staff where she can charge the phone.
explanation: Mia needs the phone to display or scan her ticket, but its battery is nearly empty. Finding a way to charge it protects the immediate goal. The other actions either waste battery or risk losing the ticket. The correct answer is D.
solutionSteps: ["Identify Mia's immediate need: she must scan the ticket at the gate.","Check the constraint: the phone has only 2% battery, so she should preserve power and seek charging help.","Finding a charger or asking staff is the useful first action; choose D."]
teacherTip: In practical-reading questions, connect the person's goal, constraint, and safest next action.

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 因果連接詞的語意判讀
question: The bus was delayed by heavy traffic. ___, Nina arrived after the movie had started.
explanation: Heavy traffic delayed the bus, and Nina arrived late as a consequence. “As a result” expresses that cause-and-effect relationship. The other choices signal contrast or an example, which does not fit.
solutionSteps: ["Identify the cause: heavy traffic delayed the bus.","Identify the outcome: Nina arrived after the movie started.","Choose the connector that introduces a consequence: “As a result”; answer C."]
teacherTip: Match the connector to the logic: cause followed by consequence takes “as a result.”
relatedWords: ["delay（延誤）","heavy traffic（交通壅塞）","as a result（因此）"]

subject: 英文
question: Read the notice: “The path from the east gate to the station is closed for repairs after 5 p.m. Visitors arriving later should enter through the west gate and follow the blue signs.” A visitor arrives at 6 p.m. What should the visitor do?
optionA: Enter through the west gate and follow the blue signs.
optionB: Wait at the east gate until the path reopens.
optionC: Follow the blue signs to the east gate.
optionD: Use the closed path because it is the shortest route.
answerText: Enter through the west gate and follow the blue signs.

solutionSteps: ["定位時間條件：east gate 路徑在下午五點後封閉。","訪客六點抵達，符合公告中的 after 5 p.m. 條件。","依指示從 west gate 進入並沿藍色標誌走，答案為 A。易錯點：不要因東門可能較近，就忽略該路徑已關閉。"]

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 根據安全事故資料推論
question: Before a guardrail was installed, a mountain road had four cyclist falls each month. After installation, it had one fall each month. Which statement is supported?
optionB: The road is the safest road in the country.
optionC: No cyclist ever fell after installation.
optionD: The road had fewer cyclist falls after installation.
answerText: The road had fewer cyclist falls after installation.
explanation: The count fell from four cyclist falls per month to one. This supports D: “The road had fewer cyclist falls after installation.” It does not prove that the road is completely safe or the safest in the country.
solutionSteps: ["Compare the monthly counts: four before and one after.","One is fewer than four, so the data show fewer falls after installation.","The correct answer is D; avoid absolute claims not supported by the numbers."]
teacherTip: A before-and-after pattern supports a change in the count, but does not by itself prove zero risk or causation.

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 閱讀安全提示並推論建議用途
question: The hiking notice says, “The ridge trail is closed for repairs. The riverside path is open, but it can be slippery after rain. Wear shoes with good grip.” Why are sturdy shoes recommended?
optionA: They help hikers avoid slipping on the wet riverside path.
optionB: They allow hikers to use the closed ridge trail.
optionC: They keep rain from reaching the riverside path.
optionD: They replace the need to follow the trail signs.
answerText: They help hikers avoid slipping on the wet riverside path.
explanation: 公告指出雨後河岸步道可能濕滑，並建議穿著抓地力好的鞋，因此鞋子的用途是降低滑倒風險。答案 A：「They help hikers avoid slipping on the wet riverside path.」
solutionSteps: ["找出風險線索：河岸步道下雨後可能 slippery（濕滑）。","good grip 指鞋底抓地力較好，能降低在濕滑路面失足的可能。","因此 sturdy shoes 是為了避免在濕滑河岸步道滑倒，選 A。"]
teacherTip: 安全公告常以風險與建議形成因果關係；把裝備用途連回明示的危險，不要推論它能取代其他規定。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 原因連接詞 because 的句意判讀
question: The school garden remains open ___ the science club is collecting plant samples there after class.
explanation: The science club's sample collection explains why the garden remains open after class. “Because” introduces that reason, so the correct answer is D.
solutionSteps: ["Identify the result: the garden remains open after class.","Identify the reason: the science club is collecting plant samples there.","“Because” introduces a reason; choose D."]
teacherTip: Use because for a reason; so introduces a result, while although signals contrast.

subject: 英文

question: Mia: “I left my lunch at home.” Ben: “I ___ half of mine with you.”

solutionSteps: ["Mia explains the problem: she has no lunch with her.","Ben responds by volunteering to share food now, so the sentence expresses his willingness.","Use will + 原形動詞; choose D, “will share.”"]
teacherTip: When someone offers help at the moment of speaking, will + base verb can express willingness.

subject: 英文
question: The rain has stopped, ___ the soccer field is still flooded, so today's match is postponed.
explanation: The rain has stopped, which could suggest the match might resume, but the field remains flooded. “But” signals this contrast; the sentence then gives the postponement as a result. The correct answer is A, “but.”
solutionSteps: ["The first clause says the rain has stopped, which sounds favorable for playing.","The next clause gives an opposing fact: the field is still flooded.","Use “but” to connect the contrast; choose A."]
teacherTip: A contrast connector signals that the second fact goes against the expectation created by the first.

subject: 英文
question: Before each class enters the science lab, safety goggles ___ by the teacher.
explanation: The goggles receive the checking action, so the sentence needs the passive voice. “Goggles” is plural and the action is a repeated lab routine, so “are checked” is correct; choose B.
solutionSteps: ["The goggles are the thing receiving the teacher's checking action.","A repeated procedure uses present simple; a plural subject takes “are + past participle.”","“Are checked” is the correct passive form; choose B."]
teacherTip: In passive sentences, identify who receives the action; check singular/plural agreement in the be-verb.

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 依公告期限判斷是否符合退貨條件
question: A shop sign says, “Refund requests must be made within seven days and require the original receipt.” Leo bought a lamp nine days ago and still has the receipt. Which is true?
optionB: He can request a refund only without the receipt.
optionC: He has the receipt but is outside the seven-day period.
optionD: The sign says lamps cannot be returned.
answerText: He has the receipt but is outside the seven-day period.
explanation: Leo has the original receipt, but nine days have passed and the notice allows refund requests only within seven days. Therefore the correct answer is C: he has the receipt but is outside the seven-day period.
solutionSteps: ["Check the two stated requirements: request within seven days and provide the original receipt.","Leo satisfies the receipt condition, but nine days is beyond the seven-day limit.","He is outside the deadline despite having the receipt; choose C."]
teacherTip: Evaluate each condition separately; satisfying one requirement does not erase a missed deadline.

subject: 英文
question: A library expanded its study area from 40 m² to 80 m². Which adjective correctly completes the sentence: “The study area is ___ than before”?
explanation: The floor area doubled from 40 m² to 80 m², so the study area is roomier than before. “Roomy” ends in consonant + y; change y to i and add -er. The answer is D, roomier.
solutionSteps: ["Compare the measured areas: 80 m² after renovation and 40 m² before.","The study area is larger, so use the comparative adjective “roomier.”","“Roomy” ends in consonant + y: change y to i and add -er. The answer is D, roomier."]
teacherTip: Area supports a claim about roominess more directly than seat count does. Roomy ends in consonant + y, so change y to i and add -er.

subject: 英文
question: The first bus reaches the terminal at 8:10 a.m.; the final bus arrives at 11:40 p.m. Which statement is correct?
optionA: The final bus arrives later than the first bus.
optionB: The final bus arrives earlier than the first bus.
optionC: The final bus arrives as early as the first bus.
optionD: The two buses arrive at the same time.
answerText: The final bus arrives later than the first bus.
explanation: 8:10 a.m. is in the morning, while 11:40 p.m. is at night; therefore the final bus arrives later than the first. The times are more than 15 hours apart, so the other statements contradict the schedule. The correct answer is A.
solutionSteps: ["Read the two arrival times and note that 8:10 a.m. is morning but 11:40 p.m. is night.","Compare their order within the same day: 11:40 p.m. comes after 8:10 a.m.","The final bus arrives later, so choose A."]
teacherTip: For time comparisons, convert to the same time basis and check a.m./p.m. before deciding which is earlier or later.

subject: 英文

question: The picnic group used ___ cups and threw them away after one use instead of washing them.

solutionSteps: ["Locate the definition clue: the cups are thrown away after one use.","Match the description to the adjective for an item intended for one-time use.","“Disposable” means designed to be thrown away after use; choose A."]
teacherTip: Use the definition in the sentence to distinguish disposable (single-use) from durable, refillable, and washable.

subject: 英文

subject: 英文

question: After dark, the mountain pass has sharp turns and no streetlights, while the coastal road is straight and lit. Which statement best explains the difference in night-driving risk?
optionA: The pass combines sharp turns with no lights, unlike the straight, lit coastal road.

optionC: Sharp turns always make a road safer at night.
optionD: Both roads are straight and have streetlights.
answerText: The pass combines sharp turns with no lights, unlike the straight, lit coastal road.
explanation: 山路同時有急彎且沒有路燈；海岸道路則筆直並有照明。答案為 A，完整配對了兩項證據，因此最能解釋夜間駕駛風險差異。其他選項扭曲或否認題幹資訊。
solutionSteps: ["先分別記錄兩路況：山路有急彎、無路燈；海岸道路筆直、有照明。","夜間風險要用題目提供的道路特徵比較，不能自行假設車流量或天氣。","選 A，只有它同時準確描述山路和海岸道路；其餘選項與公告資訊相反。"]
teacherTip: 證據推論題須同時核對兩組資訊，勿只抓住其中一個危險特徵就忽略比較對象。
relatedWords: ["dangerous（危險，原級）","more dangerous（較危險，比較級）","most dangerous（最危險，最高級）"]

subject: 英文

solutionSteps: ["Compare the serving sizes: the new recipe makes 6 servings instead of 4.","Find the scale factor: 6 ÷ 4 = 1.5.","Scale the carrots by the same factor: 300 × 1.5 = 450 g; choose B."]
teacherTip: For a recipe, scale every ingredient by the same serving ratio; do not add the serving difference directly to the ingredient amount.

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 由空位資料推論使用情況並辨識因果限制
question: A library has 100 seats on both days. On Monday, 20 seats are empty; on Tuesday, 5 are empty. Which conclusion is best supported by these figures?
optionA: More seats were occupied Tuesday, but the figures do not explain why.
optionB: All 100 seats were occupied on Tuesday.
optionC: Only 20 people used the library on Monday.
optionD: The library added five seats on Tuesday.
answerText: More seats were occupied Tuesday, but the figures do not explain why.
explanation: On Monday, 100 − 20 = 80 seats were occupied; on Tuesday, 100 − 5 = 95. Thus more seats were occupied Tuesday, but the counts alone do not tell us why attendance differed. Tuesday was not completely full, Monday did not have only 20 users, and the capacity stayed at 100. The correct answer is A.
solutionSteps: ["Find the occupied seats by subtracting empty seats from capacity: Monday 100 − 20 = 80; Tuesday 100 − 5 = 95.","The figures show that 15 more seats were occupied on Tuesday.","Choose the conclusion supported by the counts, while avoiding an unsupported claim about the cause: A."]
teacherTip: Separate what data directly show from what they do not establish: occupancy counts support a difference, but not its cause.

subject: 英文
question: A jacket costs $80. The store gives a 25% discount. What is the sale price before tax?
explanation: First find the discount: 25% of $80 is 0.25 × 80 = $20. Subtract it from the original price: $80 − $20 = $60. The answer is C, “$60.”
solutionSteps: ["Convert 25% to 0.25 and multiply by the original $80 price: 0.25 × 80 = $20.","Subtract the discount from the original price: 80 − 20 = 60.","The sale price before tax is $60; choose C."]
teacherTip: A discount is the amount taken off; subtract that amount from the original price to get the sale price.
relatedWords: ["discount（折扣）","sale price（折後價格）","before tax（未稅）"]

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 依環境線索推論光害影響
question: At a countryside site, visitors can see many faint stars. In the city, bright streetlights illuminate the sky, and fewer faint stars can be seen. What best explains the difference?
optionA: Streetlights make the city sky darker.
optionB: Light pollution makes faint stars harder to see.
optionC: Stars exist only above the countryside.
optionD: City stars are always farther from Earth.
answerText: Light pollution makes faint stars harder to see.
explanation: The passage says bright streetlights illuminate the city sky and fewer faint stars are visible there. Artificial light brightens the background, reducing the contrast of faint stars; this is light pollution. Streetlights do not make the sky darker, and the passage gives no support for claims that stars exist only in one place or are farther away. The answer is B, “Light pollution makes faint stars harder to see.”
solutionSteps: ["Identify the observation: fewer faint stars can be seen in the city.","Connect it to the stated condition: streetlights illuminate the city sky.","Artificial light obscures faint stars against the brighter sky; choose B, light pollution."]
teacherTip: For a cause-and-effect reading question, connect the stated condition to the observed result; avoid explanations that add facts the passage never gives.
relatedWords: ["faint（微弱的／暗淡的）","illuminate（照亮）","light pollution（光害）"]

subject: 英文
question: Leo had a fever, so he stayed home. His classmates sent him the notes and told him to get well soon. Which reply best shows that Leo understands their message?

solutionSteps: ["需要同時整合免費日與開放時段，不可只核對其中一項。","星期日 4:30 p.m. 落在上午九點至下午五點的開放時間內。","答案是 B。A 太早、C 非免費日、D 已超過閉館時間。"]

subject: 英文
question: Nora usually walks to school, but today it is raining heavily. She decides to take the bus instead. Why does she take the bus today?

answerText: Because the rain makes walking inconvenient

subject: 英文
question: A: ‘Would you mind closing the window? The room is getting cold.’ B: ‘____’ Which reply politely agrees to do it?

answerText: Not at all. I’ll close it now.

subject: 英文

subject: 英文
question: The school garden is small; ____, it produces enough fresh vegetables for the entire cafeteria.

question: If the temperature drops below zero tonight, the lake ___ over by morning.
explanation: 今晚氣溫降到零度以下是未來可能條件，結果預測用 will freeze。
solutionSteps: ["找出 tonight 表未來。","條件句用現在式 drops。","可能結果用 will + 原形，選 will freeze。"]
teacherTip: 第一類條件句：If + 現在式，主句 will + 原形。

subject: 英文
question: If you mix blue paint with yellow paint, you ___ green.
explanation: 這描述可重複成立的事實，條件與結果都用現在簡單式，選 get。
solutionSteps: ["判斷混色結果是一般規律。","一般事實的 if 子句與主句都用現在式。","主詞 you 搭 get，選 B。"]
teacherTip: 描述可重複驗證的一般規律時用零類條件句；勿因出現 if 就一律改用 will。

subject: 英文
question: Observatory notice: “The indoor planetarium is open Friday evening. The outdoor telescope is available on clear nights only.” Friday's forecast says it will be cloudy. Which activity is available Friday evening?
optionC: Wait until the sky becomes clear
explanation: The planetarium is listed as open Friday evening, so visitors may choose it. The forecast is cloudy, which does not meet the telescope's clear-night requirement. The answer is B, “Visit the planetarium.”
solutionSteps: ["Check the planetarium's stated opening time: it is open Friday evening.","Compare the forecast with the telescope rule: cloudy weather is not a clear night.","The planetarium is available Friday evening; choose B."]
teacherTip: Separate each activity's availability rule; a weather restriction for the telescope does not close the indoor planetarium.

subject: 英文
question: If our classroom ___ a bigger screen, everyone could read the map more easily.
explanation: 主句 could read 暗示假設情況；第二類條件句 if 子句用過去式 had。
solutionSteps: ["觀察主句 could read。","這是假設目前教室設備不同。","if 子句用 had，選 B。"]
teacherTip: 第二類條件句 If + 過去式，主句 would/could + 原形。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 依對話線索判斷事件與感受
question: Jay: “Did you enjoy the school trip?” Mia: “Yes, but I left my camera at home, so I couldn't take any pictures.” Which statement is supported by the dialogue?
optionA: Mia took many pictures during the trip.
optionB: Jay did not go on the trip.
optionC: Mia's camera stopped working during the trip.
optionD: Mia enjoyed the trip but did not take pictures.
answerText: Mia enjoyed the trip but did not take pictures.
explanation: Mia says she enjoyed the trip, but her camera was at home, so she could not take pictures. The dialogue does not say that Jay missed the trip or that the camera broke. The correct answer is D, “Mia enjoyed the trip but did not take pictures.”
solutionSteps: ["Find Mia's direct statement about the trip: she enjoyed it.","Connect the reason and result: her camera was at home, so she could not take pictures.","Choose the statement that keeps both details, option D."]
teacherTip: In a dialogue inference question, preserve both the speaker's feeling and the stated reason; do not add an unstated event such as a broken camera.

subject: 英文
question: Unless the permission form is signed, students ___ on the field trip.
explanation: Unless 表除非；表格未簽署這個條件若不成立，學生就不能參加，使用 cannot go。
solutionSteps: ["把 unless 理解為 if...not。","未簽名是不能參加的原因。","情態助動詞 cannot 後接原形 go。"]
teacherTip: unless = if...not；can/cannot 後接原形動詞。

subject: 英文
question: The lab notice says all equipment must be returned by 3:30 p.m. A group finishes its experiment at 3:05 p.m. How many minutes does the group have to return the equipment?
explanation: The deadline is 3:30 p.m. and the group finishes at 3:05 p.m. From 3:05 to 3:30 is 25 minutes.
solutionSteps: ["Find the two relevant times: 3:05 p.m. and the 3:30 p.m. deadline.","Count from 3:05 to 3:25 as 20 minutes, then add 5 minutes to 3:30.","The group has 25 minutes; do not count from the start of the experiment."]
teacherTip: 求剩餘時間要從題目給的完成時刻算到期限，不是從活動開始時間算。

subject: 英文
question: A delivery card says: “Your parcel is at the front desk. Show a photo ID to collect it.” Mia is in the building and wants her parcel. What should she do?
optionA: Wait at home for the courier to return.
optionB: Leave the parcel at the front desk.
optionC: Go to the front desk and show a photo ID.
optionD: Ask a neighbor to collect it without identification.
answerText: Go to the front desk and show a photo ID.
explanation: The card gives the parcel's location and the collection requirement: it is at the front desk, and a photo ID is needed. Mia should go there and show her ID. The answer is C, “Go to the front desk and show a photo ID.”
solutionSteps: ["Locate the parcel from the card: it is at the front desk.","Identify the stated condition for collection: show a photo ID.","Combine the location and requirement: go to the front desk with photo ID, option C."]
teacherTip: For a pickup notice, extract both where the item is and what proof is required before deciding on the action.
relatedWords: ["parcel（包裹）","front desk（服務台）","photo ID（附照片的身分證明）"]

subject: 英文
question: A community center has five classes with 18 seats in each class. If 73 residents register for one class, how many cannot get a seat?
explanation: The selected class has 18 seats, not the combined seats of all five classes. Subtract its capacity from the 73 registrations: 73 − 18 = 55 residents cannot get a seat.
solutionSteps: ["The question asks about one class, so use 18 seats rather than multiplying by five.","Compare 73 registrations with the class capacity of 18.","73 − 18 = 55 residents cannot get a seat."]
teacherTip: 先分清單一班級與五班總容量，再依題目問法計算超出名額的人數。

subject: 英文
question: The tablet's battery is already at 0%. If it is not charged tonight, the tablet ___ during tomorrow's class.
explanation: The battery is already at 0%, so without charging it tonight, the tablet will not have power for tomorrow's class. The first conditional uses “won't work” for this future result.
solutionSteps: ["The battery is already empty; the condition is that it is not charged tonight.","這是未來可能結果。","will not 後接原形 work，選 won't work。"]
teacherTip: An uncharged battery may still have power unless its current charge is known to be empty; the stem now states it is at 0%.

subject: 英文
question: If you feel dizzy during practice, you ___ stop and tell the coach.
explanation: 對練習中感到頭暈提出安全建議，使用 should stop。
solutionSteps: ["if 子句說明可能發生的情況。","主句給予建議，而非假設結果。","should 後接原形 stop，選 A。"]
teacherTip: 條件句主句不只用 will，也可用 should、can 或祈使句表建議/指示。

subject: 英文
question: A survey of 250 residents found that 36% use the bus for their daily commute. How many residents is that?
explanation: Find 36% of 250: 0.36 × 250 = 90 residents.
solutionSteps: ["Convert 36% to a decimal: 0.36.","Multiply the total number surveyed by the proportion: 250 × 0.36.","250 × 0.36 = 90 residents."]
teacherTip: 百分率題以調查總人數為基準：總數 × 百分率，不是直接把百分數當人數。

subject: 英文
question: As soon as the science video ___, the teacher will ask three questions.
explanation: as soon as 引導未來時間子句時用現在式 ends；主句才用 will ask。
solutionSteps: ["辨認 as soon as 子句。","未來時間子句使用現在式。","主詞 video 單數，選 ends。"]
teacherTip: as soon as/when/before/after 表未來時，子句通常不用 will。

subject: 英文
question: If the water reaches 100°C at sea level, it ___.
explanation: 這是一般科學事實，使用零類條件句，兩子句都用現在簡單式。
solutionSteps: ["確認描述一般物理規律。","零類條件句條件與結果都用現在式。","主詞 it 用 boils，選 A。"]
teacherTip: 一般事實使用 If + 現在式，主句 + 現在式。

subject: 英文
question: The school notice says, “If the road remains flooded, we will hold classes online tomorrow.” The road is still flooded. What will happen tomorrow?
optionA: Classes will be canceled for the entire week.
optionB: Students will attend classes in the school building.
optionC: The school will wait until next month to decide.
explanation: The notice states that classes will be online if the road remains flooded. Since the road is still flooded, the stated condition is met; classes will be held online tomorrow. The answer is D.
solutionSteps: ["Find the notice's condition: the road remains flooded.","The question confirms that the road is still flooded, so the condition is met.","Apply the notice's result: classes will be held online; choose D."]
teacherTip: 閱讀條件公告時，先確認條件是否已成立，再套用公告明示的結果；不要自行推測未提到的安排。
relatedWords: ["notice（公告）","flooded（淹水的）","hold classes online（線上授課）"]

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 依設備公告選擇保護資料的行動
question: A phone-support page says: “Turn on cloud backup and wait for the upload to finish before replacing your phone. Photos stored only on the old device cannot be restored.” Which action best protects the photos?
optionA: Enable cloud backup and confirm the photos have uploaded before replacing the phone.
optionB: Delete the photos from the old phone before backing them up.
optionC: Replace the phone while the upload is still in progress.
optionD: Keep the photos only on the old phone.
answerText: Enable cloud backup and confirm the photos have uploaded before replacing the phone.
explanation: The support page says to wait until the cloud upload finishes before replacing the device, and warns that photos stored only on the old phone cannot be restored. The correct answer is A: “Enable cloud backup and confirm the photos have uploaded before replacing the phone.” The other actions risk deleting or losing the photos.
solutionSteps: ["Find the risk stated in the notice: photos kept only on the old device cannot be restored.","The notice requires both enabling cloud backup and waiting for the upload to finish.","Choose A; deleting photos or replacing the phone before upload completion does not protect them."]
teacherTip: For a technology notice, distinguish backup (a separate recoverable copy) from simply moving to a new device.

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 依需求門檻判讀適合地點
question: A tomato-growing guide recommends at least 6 hours of direct sunlight each day. The school roof gets 4 hours, while a community garden plot gets 7. Which place meets the recommendation?
optionA: The school roof, because it gets some sunlight.
optionB: The community garden plot, because it gets 7 hours.
optionC: Both places, because neither is completely dark.
optionD: Neither place, because tomatoes need exactly 8 hours.
answerText: The community garden plot, because it gets 7 hours.
explanation: The guide sets a minimum of 6 hours. The roof gets only 4, below that threshold; the community garden gets 7, which meets it. The answer is B, “The community garden plot, because it gets 7 hours.”
solutionSteps: ["Read the stated minimum: tomatoes need at least 6 hours of direct sunlight.","Compare each location with the threshold: 4 hours is insufficient; 7 hours meets it.","Choose the community garden plot, option B."]
teacherTip: At least 6 hours includes 6 and anything above it; compare every location against the stated minimum rather than assuming some sunlight is enough.
relatedWords: ["at least（至少）","direct sunlight（直射陽光）","recommendation（建議／建議標準）"]

subject: 英文
question: A shirt's care label says: “Wash separately in cold water. Do not bleach. Hang to dry.” Which action follows the label?
optionA: Wash it separately in cold water and hang it to dry.
optionB: Wash it with other clothes in hot water.
optionC: Use bleach to remove stains, then put it in a dryer.
optionD: Wash it in cold water together with other clothes.
answerText: Wash it separately in cold water and hang it to dry.
explanation: The label requires separate washing in cold water, prohibits bleach, and says to hang the shirt to dry. The correct answer is A, “Wash it separately in cold water and hang it to dry.” The other choices use hot water, bleach, a dryer, or fail to wash the shirt separately.
solutionSteps: ["Extract each instruction: wash separately, use cold water, do not bleach, and hang to dry.","Check option A against all four details; it follows each one.","Reject options that break at least one instruction, such as using hot water or a dryer."]
teacherTip: Care labels often combine permissions and prohibitions; check every clause, especially words such as “do not.”
relatedWords: ["separately（分開地）","bleach（漂白）","hang to dry（吊掛晾乾）"]

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 火災情境中的安全行動
question: A fire alarm sounds. Smoke is coming from the stairwell, but a marked side exit away from the smoke is clear. What should students do?
optionA: Leave through the clear side exit and alert emergency services from a safe location.
optionB: Walk through the smoke to check where it is coming from.
optionC: Use the elevator to reach the ground floor quickly.
optionD: Return to the classroom to collect personal belongings.
answerText: Leave through the clear side exit and alert emergency services from a safe location.
explanation: The stairwell is smoky, but the notice says a marked side exit is clear and away from the smoke. Students should use that safe exit and alert emergency services from a safe location. They should not investigate the smoke, use an elevator during a fire, or delay for belongings. The correct answer is A.
solutionSteps: ["Treat the alarm and smoke as an immediate danger; do not enter or investigate the smoky area.","Choose a clear exit away from smoke and alert an adult or emergency services.","Avoid elevators and do not return for belongings; choose A."]
teacherTip: In a fire, avoid smoke, use a safe exit, do not use elevators, and do not delay evacuation for belongings.

subject: 英文
question: At standard atmospheric pressure, if you heat ice above 0°C, it ___ into liquid water.
explanation: At standard atmospheric pressure, ice melts when heated above 0°C. This is a general fact, so the zero conditional uses the simple present in both clauses; “it” takes “melts.”
solutionSteps: ["The sentence describes a general phase-change fact at standard atmospheric pressure.","A general fact uses the simple present in both parts of a zero conditional.","The singular subject “it” takes “melts”; ice changes into liquid water above its melting point."]
teacherTip: 一般事實用零類條件句；相變溫度須留意壓力條件，冰在標準大氣壓下約 0°C 熔化。

subject: 英文
question: A school bus leaves at 7:35 a.m. The trip takes 28 minutes. What time does it arrive?
explanation: From 7:35 to 8:00 is 25 minutes. Adding the remaining 3 minutes gives an arrival time of 8:03 a.m.
solutionSteps: ["Count 25 minutes from 7:35 to 8:00.","The trip lasts 3 more minutes after 8:00.","The bus arrives at 8:03 a.m."]
teacherTip: 跨過整點計算時，先算到整點，再加上剩餘分鐘。

subject: 英文
knowledgePoint: 場館分區開放時間判讀
question: A museum guide says: “The ancient coin gallery closes at 4:00 p.m. Other galleries remain open until 5:00 p.m.” A visitor arrives at 4:20. What can the visitor still see?
optionB: The other galleries, but not the coin gallery.
optionC: Nothing; the whole museum is closed.
optionD: All galleries, including the coin gallery.
answerText: The other galleries, but not the coin gallery.
explanation: The coin gallery closes at 4:00, before the visitor arrives at 4:20. The other galleries stay open until 5:00, so those are still available. The correct answer is B, “The other galleries, but not the coin gallery.”
solutionSteps: ["Compare the arrival time, 4:20 p.m., with the coin gallery's 4:00 closing time.","The remaining galleries close at 5:00 p.m., so they are still open at 4:20.","Choose the other galleries only, option B."]
teacherTip: Use the closing time for each section separately; a gallery's closure does not automatically mean the entire museum is closed.

subject: 英文
